As an avid cyclist, I understand the importance of upgrading our countries bike and pedestrian infrastructure. My bipartisan America Bikes Act will expand cycling infrastructure, improve rider safety, encourage domestic bicycle manufacturing, and reinstate tax incentives for bicycle commuting.

My bipartisan Revitalize Rural America Act has been endorsed by the cities of @clearlake_CA, @cityofwoodland, and @cityofsthelena, as well as @countyofsonoma, @calcattlemen, and @NARHC1. The RRAA bill boosts access to healthcare services, makes rural housing more affordable, brings workers back to rural areas, and delivers needed relief to farmers and ranchers.

Grieving military families should not be forced to make urgent, consequential financial decisions soon after losing a loved one. Grateful to work with Gold Star families and Representatives @RepGregSteube, @RepJuanVargas, and @RepJackBergman on my GRACE for Military Survivors Act. This bill would extend the period in which surviving military families can choose how to handle their benefits, extending the window from one year to three years. This gives families the time and space they need to make critical financial decisions.
